column1: I123 B01: Preserve pending entry text when decoding modified and lock keys
column4: Root cause: os/i123/app/face_a.c:1074 and :860 treat every virtual key 0x46 as cancellation; :1068-1144 checks ch==3 but does not decode Control-C from modifiers before appending printable c. os/flair/event.c:491,530-547 supplies ordinary ASCII plus separate modifier flags and drops E0 provenance from the virtual key. Ground truth: The explicit Ctrl-Break/Ctrl-C intent at face_a.c:860 and the authored input-preservation expectation in REPORT.md L028/L034; this is not a claim that Ctrl-C is a documented Lotus shortcut. spec/toolbox_gate.h Sec 6 defines the message/modifier contract. Pickup: Decode cancellation using the actual event contract before printable insertion; preserve unmodified Scroll Lock input and preserve already committed cells. If distinguishing Break requires an ABI change, record it explicitly rather than guessing from scan code 0x46. Acceptance oracle: Extend harness/proptest/test_i123_keys.c with raw cooked events for plain Scroll Lock, Control-C, Control-Break, shifted C and ordinary c in LABEL/EDIT/range prompts. Replay keyslook and edge_more on QEMU and Bochs, then save/extract WK1 and compare the retained text. Mutants removing the modifier guard and treating Control-C as printable must fail for their named reasons. Lock the GUI trace and record a record-flair clip. column1: I123 B02: Reclaim erased default cells and reuse replacement label storage
column4: Root cause: os/i123/app/face_a.c:756-758 erases then always reapplies the format, and os/i123/core/sheet.c:388 allocates a BLANK even for the default format. sheet.c:250 allocates a replacement blob before subtracting the old live bytes at :259; compaction at :207-209 still sees both allocations. Ground truth: The authored capacity-recovery/data-preservation expectations in REPORT.md L010/L032; os/i123/core/sheet.c:308 and face_a.c:169-170 define the accepted label/store limits. ../lotus123-decomp/specs/file-formats/wk1-format.md Sec 4.1 says content-free default-format cells are omitted, while nondefault format/protection needs BLANK records. Lotus Reference p. 10-3 requires erasing contents while preserving effective format/protection. Pickup: Elide a BLANK only when absence represents exactly the same effective default format and protection. Replace equal/smaller label blobs in place or transact them without requiring duplicate live capacity; retain old contents on genuine failure. This owns allocation/recovery, not the already tracked unexplained-exhaustion diagnostic in initech-vdgd. Acceptance oracle: Add capacity and allocator cases to the sheet/Face A host oracles: 2048 cells then erase ordinary A1 and enter A2049; preserve explicit-format/protection BLANKs; 135 labels of 240 characters then equal-size/shorter replacement and genuine overflow with old bytes intact. Replay capacity and pool on QEMU/Bochs and independently parse CAPERA.WK1/POOLOUT.WK1. Mutants restoring unconditional default BLANK allocation and allocate-before-reclaim must go red. Record a record-flair clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/REPORT.md (L010, L032); docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/capacity-after-erase.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/capacity-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/extracted/capacity/CAPERA.json; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/extracted/capacity/CAPERA.WK1; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/pool-replace-full.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/pool-old-preserved.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/pool-small-replace.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/pool-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/POOL135.WK1; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/extracted/pool/POOLOUT.json

column1: I123 B03: Format supported high decimal counts without a scaled-integer ceiling
column4: Root cause: os/i123/core/fmt.c:245-248 and :784-787 multiply by 10^decimals then reject magnitudes >=9e15. The display path emits stars independently of available width; eval.c:1166-1167 turns the same fixed-text refusal into ERR for @STRING. Ground truth: Lotus Reference pp. 10-4..10-6 (PDF 222..224) and p. 13-56 (PDF 344), retained in the audit reference extractions: 0..15 decimal places, width-based display overflow, and @STRING(x,n). Real rounding/precision bytes must come from Lotus rather than an artifact-derived expected string. Pickup: Use a bounded decimal conversion that supports the documented decimal counts and separates numeric conversion from field-width overflow. Preserve the existing currency/comma signs, percent scaling, trailing reserved character and rounding rules; share the conversion where the rules agree. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-i123-wk1-roundtrip and test-i123-formula with independent real-Lotus goldens for the exact 1234.5678912345 cases, signs, zero, carry rounding, F/C/comma 12..15, percent 10..15 and @STRING. Replay formats_wide and edge_more on QEMU/Bochs; compare displayed text and extracted formula/string caches separately. Mutants restoring each 9e15 guard must fail. Record a record-flair clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/REPORT.md (L030, L033); docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/wide-format-fixed-12.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/wide-format-fixed-13.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/wide-format-currency-13.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/wide-format-comma-13.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/wide-format-percent-11.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/wide-format-sci-15.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/formats_wide-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/rendered-case-lines.json; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/empty-extra-00.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/empty-extra-01.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/edge_more-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/extracted/edge_more/EMPTY.json

column1: I123 B04: Resume Finder power actions after an asynchronous worksheet Save
column4: Root cause: os/milton/kmain.c:5715-5723 asks Quit, services the immediate callback, then equates still resident with cancellation. os/i123/app/face_a.c:1245-1247 has only opened the Save filename prompt; successful write/exit happens later at :660-662. finder_power returns at kmain.c:5738-5739 and retains no pending continuation. Ground truth: Inside Macintosh Vol VI PDF p. 345, Listing 6-8, as cited at kmain.c:5691-5704: the normal Quit routine saves documents or returns userCanceledErr. The pending-Save continuation is an authored native shutdown workflow requirement, not a DOS Lotus feature. Pickup: Represent pending quit separately from explicit cancellation and resume the original Shut Down/Restart action only after the app finishes successfully. Save failure/cancel keeps the desktop and document open. Coordinate with initech-cqej for its decline/Bochs/clip tests; its title tracks test coverage, not this asynchronous continuation defect, so L003 is not DUP. Acceptance oracle: Extend the power/tenant host state-machine oracle and test-flair-shutdown/test-flair-restart with Save -> filename -> successful exit -> one power completion, Cancel, failed save, replacement cancellation, and no-app controls. Replay power twice on QEMU and Bochs with independent WK1 extraction plus FLAIR-SHUTDOWN-SAFE/reset markers. A mutant restoring still-resident==declined must fail the deferred-Save case. Record a record-flair clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/REPORT.md (L003); docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/power-save-0-prompt.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/power-save-0-result.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/shots/power-save-1-result.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-i123/evidence/power-serial.log

column1: I123 B05: Return prompts and ordinary error notices to their proper caller
column4: Root cause: os/i123/app/face_a.c:864 sends every M_RANGE Escape through menu_mode even when A_GOTO was entered directly from READY. At :868 Return dismisses M_NOTICE only when g_error is set, but notice() at :578 sets g_notice instead. Ground truth: Lotus Reference p. 1-5 (PDF 21) explicitly allows ESC or ENTER to clear an error; chapter 1 GOTO/cancellation plus the authored caller-restoration expectation in REPORT.md L018. Audit evidence/references/manual-pdf-021.txt contains the error-key rule. Pickup: Retain the origin of direct GOTO versus slash-command range prompts and make all ordinary error notices dismiss on Return as well as Escape. Do not change menu-level Escape/backtracking or discard a pending input line on unrelated notices. Acceptance oracle: Extend test_i123_keys.c and test_i123_range_menu.c with F5/Escape from READY, nested menu range Escape, unsupported leaf/Return, invalid-GOTO/Return/Escape and saved-input controls. Replay keyslook in QEMU/Bochs and assert mode/pointer/worksheet preservation. Mutants routing all M_RANGE Escape to MENU and restoring the g_error-only Return guard must fail. Record a record-flair clip. column1: I123 B06: Render and hit-test the visible part of an oversized active column
column4: Root cause: os/i123/app/face_a.c:343 uses whole-column i123_cols_fitting (sheet.c:429-439); col_x at :350-351 rejects even the first column when zero full columns fit. paint_border at :445 and paint_pointer at :486-488 therefore omit heading and pointer although Set-Width accepts 1..240 at :719-725. Ground truth: The authored native-viewport usability requirement in REPORT.md L008 and the implemented 1..240 width contract at sheet.c:398-402; Lotus Reference chapter 12 Column. Existing native-window geometry is face_a.c:102-124. No requirement to shrink the supported width range is inferred. Pickup: Keep a partially visible first column in the view and consistently clip heading, cell, pointer and hit-testing to the actual content rectangle. Retain full 240-character storage/display width, and preserve navigation/resizing behavior. Acceptance oracle: Extend test_i123_resize.c/test_i123_hit.c and the row renderer oracle with width 240 at normal and minimum window sizes, partial first columns, neighbor navigation and clicks. Replay transfers width-240 and resize legs on QEMU/Bochs with visible heading/value/pointer assertions. A mutant returning zero visible columns for an oversized first column must fail. Record a record-flair clip. column1: I123 B07: Accept the documented leading dollar sign in numeric entry
column4: Root cause: os/i123/app/face_a.c:905-908 classifies $ as VALUE, but os/i123/core/fmt.c:653-668 accepts only an optional sign followed by digits/decimal point; commit at face_a.c:934-947 then attempts formula parsing and refuses $12.34. Ground truth: Lotus Reference p. 1-19 (PDF 35), audit evidence/references/manual-pdf-035.txt: a leading dollar sign enters the number and currency display is a separate format choice. Pickup: Recognize the documented typed-number currency prefix at the entry boundary without treating absolute formula references such as +$A$1 as numeric literals. Preserve percent, exponent, sign and invalid-input rules; capture sign/currency ordering edge cases from real Lotus before broadening the grammar. Acceptance oracle: Extend the numeric/Face A entry host oracles with $12.34 -> numeric 12.34, separate currency formatting, absolute-reference controls and invalid embedded dollars. Replay entry on QEMU/Bochs, save and independently decode the WK1 numeric record. A mutant rejecting the leading dollar must fail. Record a record-flair clip. column1: I123 B08: Supply the existing NOW evaluator with the guest clock on recalculation
column4: Root cause: os/i123/core/recalc.c:92 initializes have_now=0; eval.c:912-914 correctly requires it. os/i123/app/face_a.c:931,938,974-981 and :699-702 recalculate without supplying now/have_now anywhere in the app. The existing clock service is os/apps/tbx/tbx.h:137-139, tbx_get_clock. Ground truth: Lotus Reference p. 13-46 (PDF 334), @NOW current date/time serial refreshed at recalculation; spec/i123/wk1_formula.h and the existing date serial rules, including the Lotus 1900 convention. This is an omitted input to an implemented evaluator, not evidence that the engine lacks @NOW. Pickup: Read the real guest clock through the existing gate into valid static/BSS storage, convert to the Lotus serial and supply a coherent clock snapshot to every recalculation route and its nested context. Clock failure must remain explicit, without fixed fake success values. Clock rendering/configuration is separate from this formula input. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-i123-formula and the Face A mock with injected guest dates/times, F9, automatic edits, manual mode and nested evaluation. Replay functions on QEMU/Bochs with a locked RTC, independently check saved @NOW numeric cache and its change after a known clock step. A mutant omitting have_now or freezing the second snapshot must fail. Record a record-flair clip.
